description: Outcome-mapping conformance vectors (AD-4/AD-8, FR-7): value -> winning option under the half-open bucket rule (each threshold is the inclusive lower edge of the bucket above it). Consumed by BOTH planes — packages/shared outcome.selftest.ts (winningOptionIndex) and contracts/test/LeagueCoreResolve.t.sol (LeagueCore.winningOptionOf) — so edge-semantics drift fails CI instead of surfacing in a live rebuild diff. Values and boundaries are 1e18 fixed-point int256 decimal strings. The reference vector is the blind-verified 2026-08-22 Lido receipt figure against the gateway suites' single 2.30% threshold.

vectors.name: negative rebase lands in the bottom bucket
one wei-of-yield below the first threshold
exactly on a threshold takes the upper bucket
exactly on the last threshold: top bucket
